description: This is the main source file (`main.dart`) for a Flutter-based personal notes app. It contains the main widget, theming, data model, local database management using sqflite, state management with Provider, and UI screens for listing, creating, editing, and viewing notes.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a note with id, title, content, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: NotesLocalDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class handling SQLite database operations for CRUD actions on notes.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management class extending ChangeNotifier to manage note list, search, and CRUD operations.

classes.name: NotesHomeScreen
classes.description: Main UI screen displaying list of notes, with search, delete, and navigation to editor and details.

classes.name: NotesSearchDelegate
classes.description: Custom SearchDelegate providing search functionality for notes.

classes.name: NoteEditorScreen
classes.description: Screen for creating a new note or editing an existing one, with form validation.

classes.name: NoteDetailsScreen
classes.description: Screen showing detailed view of a note with options to edit or delete.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point, runs the Flutter app with the root widget.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from the database, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves a new note or updates an existing note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database by id.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for various widgets, including the main app, screens, and search delegate.
